target.meaning: Absolute path equal to DnsManager’s selected laptop-home-arpa.conf under the managed drop-in directory (normally /etc/unbound/unbound.conf.d). The directory and file must not be symlinks.

dropIn.meaning: Nonempty UTF-8 Unbound text, at most 8192 bytes and without NUL. Starts with server: after trimming the first line. The following two indented local-data lines must each supply one laptop.home.arpa. IN A record, one for 192.168.123.19 and one for 192.168.123.20, without duplicates.

dry-run.meaning: Report the candidate hashes after input validation without staging, validating the configuration with Unbound, reloading or mutating.

action.meaning: Apply or report a read-only plan.

beforeHash.meaning: SHA-256 of prior bytes, or null for an absent file.

stagedValidation.meaning: Whether the staged configuration passed validation.

liveValidation.meaning: Whether the installed configuration passed validation.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Whether the stop reports a mutation.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class named by the front door when the stop raises instead of answering.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The stop outcome; none names an unblocked result. The envelope reader names missing kernel fields in seat order (the single missing timestamp is listed). Variable diagnostics include dns-root-config-unreadable:, command failed:, reload-command-failed:unbound:, OS errors, and an appended dns-rollback-failed: cause when restoration fails. An exception that escapes the stop is named by the front door, with its exception type.
